statement: Retain the normal-bundle H2 extension class; pi2=0 does not imply a split extension.
Restrict to a category in which the equalizer is finite flat and the required torsor reductions exist; variable-base maps cannot be admitted without this.
Use the punctured complement of the normal-crossing divisor for the rank-two inertia expression; the unpunctured strictly henselian spectrum has trivial pi1.
The finite étale version is valid; the arbitrary nonseparated étale version is false.
Ordinary étale pi1 of the rational nodal curve is full Zhat, including its p-component.
Use uniformly continuous maps to discrete sets, or a finite compact inverse system; ordinary continuity is insufficient.
